observations.type: raw knockback/recoil fields with documented runtime interpretation
mechanics: Special impact forces are applied only after effective enemy damage to a surviving player, then carried in authority snapshots and replayed by the same collision motor.
Airborne Trizooka commitments queue backward recoil; downing, respawn and loadout cancellation clear pending forces.
observations.limits: Original force integration semantics are unavailable. Project interprets Accel times distance scale as world acceleration, injects one 60Hz velocity increment, uses Bias as per-frame retention and Distance as travel cap. Sonar reuses .8 retention and8 raw-unit cap as explicit project defaults. Recoil Impact is converted as raw speed/frame; backwards stick multiplies by StickDownRt. These are sourced magnitudes with approximate interpretation, not verified native behavior. No numerical parity regression per user.
